attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), built a local RPM repository from packages downloaded to local storage, served it over HTTP via a systemd-managed python http.server, blocked the normal remote RHEL/subscription-manager repos at the network level (firewalld REJECT on tcp/443), and installed the `tree` package purely from the local repo while the remote repos were confirmed unreachable. Restored connectivity afterward, then performed the mandatory single-node restart with pre/post health evidence.
